boutique.vide: The shop is empty for now.
boutique.solde: Your balance: **{solde}**. Pick an item in the menu, or use `/boutique` with the "Buy an item" action.
boutique.achete: Purchase done: **{nom}** for {prix}. You have {solde} left.
boutique.achete_objet: The item is in your inventory (`/inventaire`).
boutique.retire: Item #{id} (**{nom}**) was removed from the shop. Temporary roles already sold will be removed when they expire.
boutique.refus.inconnu: This item doesn't exist or is no longer for sale.
boutique.refus.prix_change: The price of this item has just changed. Check the shop and try again.
boutique.refus.en_cours: A purchase of this item is already in progress.
boutique.refus.inventaire_plein: You already have 99 copies of this item: use some before buying more.
boutique.refus.inexistant: The role of this item no longer exists: tell the staff.
boutique.refus.gere: A role managed by an integration can't be sold.
boutique.refus.dangereux: The role {role} grants moderation or administration powers: the shop won't sell it.
boutique.refus.dangereux_salon: The role {role} grants moderation powers in a channel (channel override): the shop won't sell it.
boutique.refus.couleur_permissions: A colour role must have no permission: remove the ones of the role {role}.
boutique.refus.couleur_sans_couleur: The role {role} has no colour: pick a coloured role.
boutique.refus.bot_sous_role: The bot can't give the role {role}: it needs "Manage Roles" and a role placed above this one.
boutique.refus.admin_sous_role: You can't give the role {role} yourself (you need "Manage Roles" and a role higher than it), so you can't sell it.
boutique.refus.objet_inconnu: This item isn't in the catalogue.
boutique.refus.objet_non_vendable: This item isn't for sale yet.
boutique.refus.nom: The name must be 1 to 50 characters long.
boutique.refus.prix: The price must be a whole number from {min} to {maxprix}.
boutique.refus.stock: The stock must be a positive whole number (at least 1 when adding).
boutique.refus.duree: A temporary role needs a duration from 1 h to 90 days (option `duree`, for example 7d).
boutique.refus.doublon: This item is already in the shop.
boutique.refus.plein: The shop is full ({max} items at most): remove one first.
boutique.refus.rien: Nothing to change: give a name, a price or a stock.
boutique.refus.role_impossible_rembourse: The role couldn't be given. Your purchase was refunded: tell the staff.
boutique.refus.role_impossible: The item couldn't be delivered and the refund failed: tell the staff as soon as possible.
inv.vide: Your inventory is empty. Items are bought in the `/boutique`.
inv.refus.inutilisable: This item can't be used yet.
inv.refus.boost_actif: An XP boost is already active (ends {fin}): it doesn't stack.
